To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) search and candidate generation are two key components of the Hypothesis Generation process, which is a key phase in the IBM Watson DeepQA system; (ii) the search component retrieves content that is relevant to a given Jeopardy! question from a knowledge corpus; and (iii) the candidate generation component identifies candidate answers to a given Jeoopardy! question by using various kinds of metadata from the retrieved content.

(a) a combination of strategies for search and candidate generation can bring the correct answer into a candidate pool for 87% of all Jeopardy! questions, (b) the correct answer is brought into the candidate pool for 100% of the Jeopardy! clues that have an answer in the Jeopardy archive, (c) the candidate generation component can be improved to bring the correct answer in the candidate pool for an additional 3.7% of all questions, and

(a) the search and candidate generation strategies developed for Watson's DeepQA system are effective and complementary, and (b) the search and generation strategies are effective in generating a candidate pool that contains the correct answer for 87.7% of all Jeopardy! questions.
